queries.query: What time is official fund NAV struck?

hits.chunk_text: Official fund NAV is struck at 4 PM ET using final pricing; late-arriving prices use fair-value hierarchy Level 2 when available.

Fedwire cutoff for third-party USD wires is 5:45 PM ET; internal book transfers may settle later.
